text:
Maya (Finance): Heads up — Aurora Health is asking for a one-off SKU bundle discount + 6mo trial credits. Need deal-desk + legal signoff before we send updated T&C. Details below.
Jon (Sales): Customer is a small pilot, high chance of expansion to dedicated capacity if trial goes well. Asking for 30% off list for first 6 months and waive overage for first quarter.
Priya (AE): Confirmed. Their expected consumption: 250M tokens/month initially. Forecasted ARR uplift if converted: ~$220k/yr.
Maya (Finance): Quick economics: baseline list is $0.02/1k tokens. With 30% off + credits we net approx $0.014/1k during trial. Margin hit but strategic.
Maya (Finance): Snippet of numbers:
```
Month 1-3: 250M tokens/mo -> $5k list/mo -> $3.5k after 30% off
Trial credit bucket: $10k one-time applied across months 1-2
Overage waiver first 90 days -> revenue deferred if they exceed cap
```
Ellen (Deal Desk): Can approve a one-off up to 25% without exec review. 30% needs manager approval. Also need a signed addendum documenting credits and overage waiver cap.
Jon (Sales): Can we move to 29%? :sweat_smile: Customer is pushing for 30 but we can compromise.
Ravi (Legal): I need the addendum draft; also confirm data residency clause — Aurora requires EU data routing. If Private deployment is requested that's a different cost bucket.
Priya (AE): They're ok with hosted but insist on EU routing. No private deployment for pilot.
Maya (Finance): Given margins and strategic potential I propose: 29% discount, $10k trial credit, overage waiver capped at 400M tokens/month for first 90 days. Requires Ellen (Deal Desk) + Ravi (Legal) signoff.
Ellen (Deal Desk): I can sign for 29% and the credit if Sales adds a clear rollback clause and the addendum has metrics to trigger conversion (auto-convert to paid pricing on month 7).
Ravi (Legal): Ok to proceed on draft addendum. Need to include: term length, credit exhaustion behavior, EU routing confirmation, termination/rollback. I can review the doc by EOD.
Jon (Sales): I'll get customer to agree to conversion trigger language.
Maya (Finance): Final approval checklist: Finance (Maya) approves economics, Deal Desk (Ellen) approves discount up to 29%, Legal (Ravi) to sign addendum. Can we get signoffs here?
Ellen (Deal Desk): +1, approves 29% and $10k credit contingent on addendum. :thumbsup:
Ravi (Legal): +1 pending addendum I draft.
Priya (AE): Customer confirmed verbally, awaiting doc.
OpsBot: Document created: /contracts/aurora-health/1762345678-addendum-draft-v1 (owner: Ravi).
Maya (Finance): Great — I'll mark this as approved for billing to accept the one-off once addendum is signed. Thanks team.
Jon (Sales): Thanks all — I'll push the doc today and loop back when signed. :rocket:
